signIn.title: Staff sign-in
signIn.intro: Authorised Confiance staff only. Every access is logged.
signIn.accountReady: Your account is ready. Sign in with your new password.
signIn.firstTimeBody: An administrator gave you an invite code: use it to create your password.
signIn.forgotten: Forgotten your password? Ask an administrator for a new invite code, then choose “Set up my account”.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.

enroll.title: Set up my account
enroll.intro: Enter your work email address, the invite code an administrator gave you, and the password you want to use.
enroll.codeHint: Dashes, spaces and capital letters do not matter.
enroll.ruleBytes: At most {{maxBytes}} bytes: an accented letter counts 2, some symbols 3 or 4 (currently {{bytes}})
enroll.ruleNotEmailName: Does not contain the part of your email before the @

notConfigured.title: Server not configured
notConfigured.body: This build of the dashboard has no Supabase settings (VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY). Tell the technical team.

noAccess.title: No staff access yet
noAccess.body: You are signed in as {{email}}, but this account has no active staff profile.
noAccess.next: Ask an administrator to activate your access, then sign in again.

copy.failed: Could not copy: select the link and copy it by hand.

testSession.title: Test sessions
testSession.intro: Creates a rider link to try the capture flow on a phone. The session is flagged as a test and the link expires after a few minutes.
testSession.qrLabel: QR code of the rider link
testSession.scan: Scan a QR code with the phone's camera, or send a link to the phone.
testSession.debugQrLabel: QR code of the debug link
testSession.debugHint: The debug link opens the same session, and the phone also shows its measurements and what it read from the code lines (✅/❌ for each check digit).
testSession.expired: This link has expired. Create a new test session.

recent.title: Recent verifications
recent.assignedOnly: You only see the verifications assigned to you.

case.title: Verification {{id}}
case.notFoundBody: This case does not exist or is not available to you.
case.linkUsed: No longer usable (case submitted or closed)
case.viewsLogged: Every photo view is recorded in the audit log. Each link works for 60 seconds.
case.photoRemoved: The link expired and the photo was removed from the page. Open it again if needed.
case.photoLoadFailed: The photo could not be loaded. The link may have expired: open it again.

mrz.title: Code lines (MRZ)
mrz.intro: Read on the rider's phone. The server checked the lines again itself: the phone's own verdict is not used.

expectedOn.document_front: This document carries its code lines on the front: {{format}}.
expectedOn.document_back: This document carries its code lines on the back: {{format}}.

mrz.optional: They are optional on this document: the rider was never asked to retake the photo for them.
mrz.none: This document has no code lines: nothing to read.
mrz.notReceivedBody: The phone sent no reading result for this photo.
mrz.noPhotoYet: No photo of this side yet.
mrz.detailsUnknown: The details of this result could not be read.

unreadable.not_found: Not readable on the phone: no code lines were found on the photo.
unreadable.reader_unavailable: Not readable on the phone: the reader could not run on it (old browser, or its files did not load).

checks.documentCode: Document code fits the declared document

mrz.dataLogged: Every view of the data read is recorded in the audit log. It stays on screen for 60 seconds.
mrz.dataRemoved: The time was up and the data was removed from the page. Show it again if needed.
mrz.noData: No code lines were stored for this case.
mrz.unparsable: These lines could not be interpreted.
mrz.rawLines: Lines as read by the phone

capture.reused: Image already used in another verification

errors.bad_request: The request was not accepted. Check the details and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign out, then sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Your account has no active staff access.
errors.forbidden_role: Your role does not allow this action.
errors.not_found: Not found, or not visible to you.
errors.invalid_session: This verification link is not valid.
errors.already_submitted: This verification has already been submitted.
errors.consent_required: The rider has not given consent yet.
errors.document_type_required: The document type has not been chosen yet.
errors.invalid_kind: This side is not expected for this document.
errors.missing_sides: One or more sides of the document are missing.
errors.too_many_uploads: Too many uploads for this session.
errors.upload_missing: The uploaded photo could not be found.
errors.invalid_image: The file is not a valid JPEG image.
errors.image_too_small: The image file is too small.
errors.image_too_large: The image file is too large.
errors.image_resolution_too_low: The image resolution is too low.
errors.invalid_mrz: The code lines (MRZ) sent were not accepted.
errors.audit_failed: The access could not be recorded in the audit log, so the photo is not shown. Try again in a moment.
errors.invalid_invite: This invite code is not valid for this email address: it may be mistyped, expired or already used. Ask an administrator for a new code.
errors.weak_password: This password is not accepted. Use between {{min}} and {{max}} characters and at most {{maxBytes}} bytes (an accented letter counts 2), without the part of your email before the @, and avoid common passwords.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.not_configured: This build has no server settings. Tell the technical team.
errors.enrollBadRequest: Check the email address and the invite code.
errors.testSessionRole: Only supervisors and administrators can create test sessions.
errors.adminNoImageAccess: Administrators have no routine access to ID images. A supervisor or the assigned reviewer can open them.
errors.photoNotFound: This photo is no longer available, or this case is not assigned to you.
errors.adminNoDataAccess: Administrators have no routine access to data read from ID documents. A supervisor or the assigned reviewer can show it.
errors.documentDataNotFound: This case is no longer available, or it is not assigned to you.
errors.documentDataAuditFailed: The access could not be recorded in the audit log, so the data is not shown. Try again in a moment.
